name: Marcelo Bentivoglio
profile: Co-founder and CFO of QI Tech, the Brazilian financial-infrastructure (banking/credit-as-a-service) unicorn, which he joined as CFO around its 2018 founding (one Insper report says 2021). He leads fundraising, including rounds from GIC and General Atlantic.
interesting_fact: On IPO plans (South Summit Brazil, Apr 2025): 'Hoje, eu não tenho nada a fazer com o dinheiro... Seria um IPO por ego' - he views an IPO purely as a financial transaction.
deep_cut_fact: His fundraising philosophy, from a 2025 interview: 'Muita gente olha para a captação como um prêmio, eu olho como um compromisso' (many see a raise as a prize; I see it as a commitment).
notes: Not listed among founders on QI Tech's own About page (which lists Mac Dowell, Buosi, Emilio Moreira), though press calls him co-founder.

name: Manmahesh Kantipudi
current_role: Managing Director and CEO, Aragen Life Sciences (Hyderabad)
profile: Known as Manni Kantipudi, he leads Aragen Life Sciences (formerly GVK Biosciences), an Indian CRDMO serving pharma and biotech in discovery, development, manufacturing and biologics, with sites in Hyderabad, Bengaluru and Morgan Hill, California. He has run the business through its rebrand and Goldman Sachs investment and toward an IPO.
interesting_fact: Aragen rebranded from GVK Biosciences and brought in Goldman Sachs as an investor; it now has a US biologics campus in Morgan Hill, CA.
deep_cut_fact: An engineer by training, he holds a bachelor's in computer science engineering from the University of Mumbai; per his org-chart profile he worked at Intel before joining the company in 2007 as President.
notes: Hurun lists him as a founder; Aragen's official promoters are D.S. Brar and Keshav G.V. Reddy. Intel detail is from theorg.com (secondary).

name: Hemant Daga
current_role: Co-founder and CEO, Neo Asset Management (Neo Group), Mumbai
profile: Co-founded Neo Group in 2021 and runs its asset-management arm, focused on private credit, fixed income and real assets. Earlier he spent ~16 years at Edelweiss, rising to CEO of Edelweiss Asset Management, after starting at ICICI Bank.
interesting_fact: At Edelweiss he was credited as one of the key people who grew the CDPQ-backed alternatives business to about USD 4 billion.
deep_cut_fact: He joined Edelweiss in 2005 as a proprietary trader, after starting his career at ICICI Bank, before building its alternatives franchise.
